hints.title: Forward Match Suffix
hints.text: Scan forward matching each character of s2 in s1 sequentially until the entire subsequence is found.

hints.title: Reverse Contraction
hints.text: Once the end of s2 is reached, scan backwards from that position in s1 to find the optimal, rightmost start position for s2.

hints.title: Advance Scan
hints.text: Record this candidate window if its length is smaller than previous windows. Then resume the forward search from start plus one.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Forward match to find subsequence end followed by backward contraction to find tightest start.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking every possible substring of s1 for s2 as a subsequence costs O(M^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bidirectional pointer passes operate in-place with O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use forward scan to anchor end and reverse scan to minimize start index.
